dicom_input_prefix.description: S3 prefix containing DICOM files. HealthOmics localizes the entire prefix into a directory before the task runs; nested layout is preserved.

deidentification_profile.description: S3 path to a JSON de-identification profile. Use profiles/ps315_basic_tcia_v1.json as a starting point and replace the salt with a project-specific secret before staging.

container.description: ECR container image URI. Build and push it once with `./build_and_push_container.sh --account-id <id> --region <region>` and pass the resulting URI here.

emit_jpeg_previews.description: When true, write a before/after JPEG pair per instance into <output>/jpeg_previews/ for visual verification of mask placement.
